sentences.text: This appeal by the claimant is directed against the impugned judgment and award dated 22.03.2017 passed in M.V.C. No.988/2015 by the XI Additional District & Sessions Judge & Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi (for short, 'the Tribunal'), whereby the said claim petition was dismissed by the Tribunal.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge & Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that the claimant filed the aforesaid claim petition seeking compensation towards injuries sustained by her inter alia contending that when she was proceeding on motor cycle bearing registration No.MH-10/V-7383 towards Sangli, as a pillion rider of the motor cycle which was being driven by her husband, the offending tractor and trailers bearing registration No.MH-10/S-1657 and CNL-5571 & 5572 came NC: 2023:KHC-D:10793-DB in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the motor cycle resulting in grievous injuries being sustained by the claimant in the accident.

The said claim petition was contested by the respondent-insurance on various grounds, and after permitting both the parties to adduce oral and documentary evidence, the Tribunal dismissed the petition on the ground that the claimant had not proved her claim.

3. During the pendency of the present appeal, the appellant has filed an application I.A. No.1/2020 under Order XLI Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 seeking permission to produce additional documents/evidence.

Though the said application is vehemently opposed by the learned counsel for respondent No.2-insurance company, the said documents produced along with I.A.

2023:KHC-D:10793-DB Tribunal deserves to be set aside and the matter remitted back to the Tribunal for reconsideration afresh in accordance with law by leaving open all contentions.

sentences.text:
4. In the result, we pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is hereby allowed.
ii) The impugned judgment and award, dated 22.03.2017, passed in M.V.C.
No.988/2015 by the Tribunal is hereby set side.
iii) I.A. No.1/2020 is allowed and the documents filed along with the application are received on record.
iv) The matter is remitted back to the Tribunal for reconsideration afresh in accordance with law.
v) Liberty is reserved in favour of the parties to place additional oral and documentary evidence in support of their respective claims.
All rival contentions are kept open and no opinion is expressed on the same.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:10793-DB vi) Parties undertake to appear before the Tribunal on 25.10.2023 without awaiting/seeking further notice from the Tribunal.
vii) The Tribunal is directed to dispose of the claim petition as directed in the present order within a period of three months from 25.10.2023.
Registry is directed to transmit the trial Court records and I.A. No.1/2020 and accompanying documents to the Tribunal forthwith for reconsideration in accordance with law.
